title: Chatlo - AI Chat & Agent App - App Store
excerpt: Download Chatlo - AI Chat & Agent by 庆彬 邓 on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like Chatlo - AI Chat & Agent.
content_html:
Privacy-First AI Assistant

Free · In‑App Purchases · Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS.

Chatlo is an AI Native Agent built for getting things done. Use DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, Qwen, Jev, or local NanoJev MLX. or local AI offline. BYOK & 100% private. Chatlo goes beyond chat. It searches, analyzes, plans, and takes action — turning your ideas into results, right on your iPhone and iPad. [AI That Gets Things Done] Chatlo doesn't just answer questions. It can plan and complete tasks for you. • Research a topic and organize the results • Search, analyze, and summarize information • Organize Health and activity data • Plan your schedule and to-dos • Read and summarize long content • Choose the right tools for each task Tell Chatlo what you want to accomplish. It handles the steps. [Any AI, Your Choice] Use the AI that works best for you. • DeepSeek、Kimi、GLM、MiniMax、Qwen and 10+ AI models and services • Jev AI • Local NanoJev MLX • Bring your own API key • Connect directly to AI providers • No middleman and no extra markup • Switch between models anytime No lock-in. Your models, your choice. [Privacy First] Your data stays under your control. • API keys are stored only on your device • No Chatlo backend servers • No usage tracking • Local AI can run completely offline • iCloud sync is optional From cloud AI to local AI, you decide how your data is used. [Built Into Your iPhone] Chatlo works with the capabilities already on your iPhone and iPad. • Access steps, sleep, heart rate, workouts, and other Health data • Recognize and understand photos • Run Shortcuts • Read clipboard content • Use system capabilities to complete more tasks • Fully optimized for iPhone and iPad With your permission, Chatlo can connect AI with the data and tools on your device. [Local AI] Run supported AI models directly on your device. No API key. No cloud connection. No internet required. Your conversations can stay entirely on your device — ideal for offline use and privacy-sensitive tasks. [Skills, MCP & Tools] Extend what Chatlo can do with Skills, MCP, and tool integrations. From web search and research to analysis and task execution, you can add new capabilities as your needs grow. Chatlo isn't limited to a fixed set of features. It's an AI assistant that grows with you. Chatlo — from asking to getting things done.
